title: YSZ Villa
paragraphs: In the YSZ Villa the atmosphere is elegantly eclectic – a pointed reference to the home’s future inhabitants. Natural materials like wood and marble coexist with mid-century furniture and 21st century art.
We created a warm interior using a Canaletta Walnut and Smoked Mirror panel cladding on the full height of the staircase wall. In the kitchen and bathrooms, we used natural Calacatta Gold marble.
Kitchen: Poliform
Wardrobes: Poliform, Orme
In collaboration with Christia Angelidou Architects https://angelidouarchitects.com/

title: The Collector’s Club
paragraphs: Intimate seating areas are formed to create a series of living room vignettes, mixing voluminous furniture with made-to-measure creations. Magic lies in the assemblage of disparate objects for guests to immerse themselves.
Furniture: Connubia, Natuzzi Editions
In collaboration with Christia Angelidou Architects https://angelidouarchitects.com/

title: Seaside Dwelling
paragraphs: Overlooking the Mediterranean Ocean, a ‘Seaside Dwelling’ perched on the coast of Pervolia serves as a vacation home. In a reductive approach, set about instilling a softness and flow that leads from one space seamlessly into another and from the internal to external spaces.
Kitchen: Poliform
Wardrobes: Orme
In collaboration with Christia Angelidou Architects https://angelidouarchitects.com/

title: Golden Glow Nest
paragraphs: The living room is characterised by an engaging variety of objects, furniture and atmospheric lighting. The Wall System by Poliform exhibits traditional Greek-Cypriot art pieces and Christia’s own sculptures.The sofa and coffee table collection named ‘Sydney’ are by Poliform and designed by Jean-Marie Massaud. The ‘Mad Joker’ armchair is also by Poliform and designed by Marcel Wanders.

Located in a quiet neighbourhood in one of the most prominent downtown residential areas of the capital city, the penthouse overlooks the surrounding greenery of the nearby residences – a calming gateway from the couple’s busy schedule.
In collaboration with Christia Angelidou Architects https://angelidouarchitects.com/

title: Serene Apartment
paragraphs: An understated elegance characterises this serene apartment, located in the heart of the city. Refined with soft furnishings and neutral colour hues that accentuate the abundance of natural light, which floods the apartment.

The open plan living, dining and kitchen area, presents a versatile yet laid back aesthetic. Consisting of shades of driftwood taupe, misty grey, olive green and shell pink, as well as textures of concrete, Travertine stone and Calacatta Gold marble.
In collaboration with Christia Angelidou Architects https://angelidouarchitects.com/

title: NICOSIA APARTMENT
paragraphs: New and refreshed apartment in the centre of Nicosia.

title: Mid-Century Modern Villa
paragraphs: This Villa is characterised by clean, simple lines, pops of yellows and oranges, and plenty of wood and neutral fabrics. A sleek mid-century modern style villa, which makes a statement that's big on character, contours and colour so sits extremely well within the vibrant, eclectic designs Takis Angelides Furnihome interior designers employ.

title: New Elegance
paragraphs: Cultivating the ideal inviting home is something of an art. This modern interior design villa benefits from a little splash of joy here and there. For example, an eye-catching lighting piece along with some carefully selected furnishings. Experimenting with some playful elements helped to lift each room of this villa and made it look fun and inviting. It’s all about juxtaposing the two opposing themes 'Whimsical and Minimal' perfectly. Adding a splash of colour to sleek designer seats in tones that truly make a statement.

title: Modern Rustic Office
paragraphs: The result of this modern rustic office is stunning - lavish sophistication displayed with modest simplicity. The lack of too much ornamentation, the arrangement of straight lines, and the clear restriction in the number of furniture pieces, celebrates the minimalist trends against the sandstone walls of the 1940s building. The colour palette is predominantly neutral and monochromatic, adding cosy depth and balance to the work environment.

title: Nordic Spirit
paragraphs: A timeless villa interior inspired by the sea and mountains of its location. An effortlessly cool Nordic interior was achieved with pared back cosiness, clean lines and plenty of texture. For Takis Angelides Furnihome interior designers it is about keeping things simple and investing in quality and strong furniture forms. The colour palette was kept natural and just used mint and green to add interest.

title: Light & Airy Seaside Apartment
paragraphs: Frеѕh, rеlахеd and ехсіtіnglу vеrѕаtіlе, јuѕt lіkе thе осеаn thаt іnѕріrеd it, this cоаѕtаl-themed apartment tаkеѕ оrgаnіс іnѕріrаtіоn into new dіmеnѕіоnѕ. Іnѕtеаd of mеrеlу еmbеllіѕhіng thе іntеrіоr wіth осеаnіс mаtеrіаlѕ, mоtіfѕ and еlеmеntѕ, the Takis Angelides Furnihome interior designers went а ѕtер further and оffеred an аеѕthеtіс thаt іѕ integrally sun kіѕѕеd and nаutісаl in tоnе. Natural lіght in abundant рrороrtіоnѕ іѕ of соurѕе раrаmоunt, рlауfullу bоunсіng off thе соntrаѕt of whіtе and blue thаt ѕеt this apartment іntеrіоr араrt.

title: Silver Villa
paragraphs: This contemporary interior style Villa is all about clean-lined comfort. Furniture show exposed silver-leaf legs and smoked mirror surfaces to create a feeling of space. Square corners and right angles are balanced with curved edges. Plush textures, like velvet and soft linen, maximise cosiness.

title: Cosy Home
paragraphs: This home achieves an atmosphere that’s as warm and inviting as it is sleek and simple. The living room is decorated in beige and red tints, giving it a very soft and cosy look, while as the bedrooms have yellow, blue and beige colours, which makes them very warm and inviting. Aside from the statement art, the armchair in the living-room and the chaise-longue in the bedrooms area are the decor that stand out for their unique design and storytelling capabilities.

title: Classy Villa
paragraphs: This mid-century modern villa combines neutral furniture with bold, colourful accents. A focus on details, on the excellence of the materials and on a gritty yet sober interior design, pervades all the spaces, making them unique, timeless and immune to fashion. A deep petrol blue was our expert pick for the accent colour in each space, as it embodies depth alongside warmth; cool with calm; it’s cosily enveloping, yet never overwhelming. Perfect qualities for any home.

title: Minimalist Office
paragraphs: This minimalist office design works on the principle that less is more. Using simple furniture forms and taking away layers without losing the aesthetic appeal of each space. The focus is on shape, colour and texture. Colour is used sparingly in the Lobby area not to distract or detract from the simplicity of the room.

title: Light Flooded Home
paragraphs: This contemporary home was designed with furnishings that have more distinctive forms, including curved furnishings. Fundamentally, the contemporary style of decorating each space was defined by simplicity, subtle sophistication, deliberate use of texture, and clean lines. By focusing on colour, space, and shape, this light flooded home interiors are sleek and fresh. The palette was punched up and accented with bright and bold colours, like yellow and blue that play against neutrals.

title: Stylish Home
paragraphs: Stark and timeless designs that are almost sculptural in quality, define this mid-century modern style home. You will find indoor and outdoor furniture, kitchen and wardrobe designs where form follows function, with uncluttered and sleek lines. Use of traditional material, such as wood, and non-traditional materials such as metal, glass, marble, and mirror exist side by side. Materials and finishes are juxtaposed to explore texture, creating a look that will stand the test of time.

title: Calligaris & Connubia
paragraphs: The Takis Angelides Furnihome family have re-designed their Nicosia showroom with stylish, modern Italian designs by the Calligaris brand and presented them to the Cypriot market in March 2019. Soon, they will introduce a new studio by the Italian purveyor Calligaris in Limassol, and they aren't stopping there.

Calligaris has long been established by its award-winning Italian modern design and great price points. The new studio space in Nicosia mirrors typical houses in Cyprus, with high ceilings, as well as intimate spaces, showcasing designs the way they would look at home.
Calligaris's designs are also customizable, making them an appealing option for the sea-side villa and the cosy one-bedroom alike.

title: A Beautiful Mix of Old & New
paragraphs: Executive office furniture designs, with modern and sleek lines are juxtaposed with the classic touch of the existing wooden cladding, in this Embassy interiors. The form and function were equally prioritized by keeping the working style and needs in mind. Special attention was paid to the overall character and atmosphere of the place as Embassy executives host many important guests. Therefore, the interiors were carefully designed to represent an understated elegance with a touch of comfort in the mix.

title: Classic Style Spaces
paragraphs:
Formal style interiors are defined by materials of exceptional quality, clear geometric shapes and the lack of 'unnecessary frills'.

A design style that tends to be luxurious, over-the-top and opulent. Whether you’re after a look that is Art Deco and Hollywood Glam or Classic and Traditional, adding some key vintage style pieces can help you bring the room together.

title: Inspiring Office Spaces
paragraphs: The office world reflects the constant evolution of working concepts and practices. Designing these spaces means finding solutions to a series of interwoven requirements, such as flexibility and multifunctionality, sharing and privacy. The synergic interaction between different products – partition walls, acoustic panels and furnishing systems – makes it possible to shape the different functions into a dynamic flow, ensuring all the necessary operative infrastructure as well as absolute comfort.

title: Fresh White Villa
paragraphs: This coastal-style Villa adopts a more contemporary approach to the theme. Subtle nods to seaside living work beautifully without overdoing it. Natural materials, plenty of glass and breezy white draperies, combine to create a spacious coastal haven.
